race.title: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: FIRST CONFESSION found 3¾m too much of a test at Cheltenham when last seen in March but back over a more suitable trip in a lesser handicap, he could get on the up returning for his in-form stable. Broomfields Cave and Arizona Cardinal also reappear, the latter from a huge lay-off but both are interesting. FIRST CONFESSION (IRE) BROOMFIELDS CAVE (IRE) ARIZONA CARDINAL
race.bettingForecast: Broomfields Cave (13/8), Jupiter Allen (2/1), Blenkinsop (4/1), Arizona Cardinal (8/1), First Confession (10/1)
